id: title:adamleithp:prevent app unmount during background access rechecks

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop agent authentication and session management. The change distinguishes between token rejection (401) and permission denial (403), preventing unnecessary token refresh or retry on permission errors, and adds checks for background access rechecks and project markers.
review.reason: The observed changes implement a specific authentication behavior: distinguishing 401 (token rejection) from 403 (permission denied) to avoid unnecessary session rebuilds, and adding guards for background access and project markers. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in authentication reliability and session management for the Desktop agent. No tier 3 systemic risk,
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation of helper functions referenced in P1.F5 and P1.F6 is not supplied, and P1.F7 implementation is not supplied, so the full behavior and test coverage cannot be verified. The score relies on the supplied hunks demonstrating the authentication and access guard changes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is made here; scoring is done after reviewing the complete group.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that a 403 response does not trigger token refresh or retry.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop agent authentication: prevents unnecessary session rebuilds when permission is denied.

observations.behavior: Changes the authentication status check to only treat 401 as a token rejection, not 403.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop agent authentication: distinguishes token expiry (401) from permission denial (403).

observations.behavior: Updates the conditional to use the new token rejection status check instead of the old one.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop agent authentication: applies the corrected token rejection check to the request flow.
